item.title: Queen bees emerge from special wax chambers
item.description:
📝 The wax used to make queen cells is chemically and architecturally distinct from the wax of worker cells. The new findings align with his earlier research that found that different worker genotypes show distinct preferences for either queen or worker rearing. Share Queen bees emerge from special wax chambers Royal wax, as well as royal jelly, determines the fate of a honeybee larva cen.
